arxiv-2202-05121.title: The factorization problem for Jordan algebras. Applications Thanks: This work was supported by a grant of the Ministry of Research, Innovation and Digitization, CNCS/CCCDI–UEFISCDI, project number PN-III-P4-ID-PCE-2020-0458, within PNCDI III
arxiv-2202-05121.creator: A. L. Agore, G. Militaru
arxiv-2202-05121.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. L. Agore, G. Militaru. We investigate the factorization problem as well as the classifying complements problem in the setting of Jordan algebras. Matched pairs of Jordan algebras and the corresponding bicrossed products are introduced. It is shown that any Jordan algebra which factorizes through two given Jordan algebras is isomorphic to a bicrossed product associated to a certain matched pair between the same two Jordan algebras.

arxiv-2209-02927.title: Network-aware Prefetching Method for Short-Form Video Streaming
arxiv-2209-02927.creator: Duc Nguyen, Phong Nguyen, Vu Long, Truong Thu Huong, Pham Ngoc Nam
arxiv-2209-02927.description: Abstract Recent years have witnessed the rising of short-form video platforms such as TikTok. Apart from conventional videos, short-form videos are much shorter and users frequently change the content to watch. Thus, it is crucial to have an effective streaming method for this new type of video. In this paper, we propose a resource-efficient prefetching method for short-form video streaming.

arxiv-2209-15343.title: Primordial black holes and gravitational waves from nonminimally coupled supergravity inflation
arxiv-2209-15343.creator: Shinsuke Kawai, Jinsu Kim
arxiv-2209-15343.description: Abstract We study the formation of primordial black holes and the generation of gravitational waves in a class of cosmological models that are direct supersymmetric analogs of the observationally favored nonminimally coupled Higgs inflation model. It is known that this type of model naturally includes multiple scalar fields which may be regarded as the inflaton.

arxiv-2307-12301.title: Image Outlier Detection Without Training using RANSAC
arxiv-2307-12301.creator: Chen-Han Tsai, Yu-Shao Peng
arxiv-2307-12301.description: Abstract Image outlier detection (OD) is an essential tool to ensure the quality of images used in computer vision tasks. Existing algorithms often involve training a model to represent the inlier distribution, and outliers are determined by some deviation measure.

arxiv-2402-04788.title: MLLM-as-a-Judge: Assessing Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge with Vision-Language Benchmark
arxiv-2402-04788.creator: Dongping Chen, Ruoxi Chen, Shilin Zhang, Yaochen Wang, Yinuo Liu, Huichi Zhou, Qihui Zhang, Yao Wan, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun
arxiv-2402-04788.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have gained significant attention recently, showing remarkable potential in artificial general intelligence. However, assessing the utility of MLLMs presents considerable challenges, primarily due to the absence of multimodal benchmarks that align with human preferences.

arxiv-2405-03243.title: Mind the Gap Between Synthetic and Real: Utilizing Transfer Learning to Probe the Boundaries of Stable Diffusion Generated Data
arxiv-2405-03243.creator: Leonhard Hennicke, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Holger Giese, Jan Mathias Koehler ∗,, Lukas Schott ∗,
arxiv-2405-03243.description: Abstract Generative foundation models like Stable Diffusion comprise a diverse spectrum of knowledge in computer vision with the potential for transfer learning, e.g., via generating data to train student models for downstream tasks. This could circumvent the necessity of collecting labeled real-world data, thereby presenting a form of data-free knowledge distillation.

arxiv-2408-16222.title: Modeling magnetization reversal in multilayers with interlayer exchange coupling
arxiv-2408-16222.creator: Elliot Wadge, Afan Terko, George Lertzman-Lepofsky, Paul Omelchenko, Bret Heinrich, Manuel Rojas, Erol Girt
arxiv-2408-16222.description: Abstract Spin spirals form inside the magnetic layers of antiferromagnetic and noncollinearly-coupled magnetic multilayers in the presence of an external field. This spin structure can be modeled to extract the direct exchange stiffness of the magnetic layers and the strength of the interlayer exchange coupling across the spacer layer.

arxiv-2409-01872.title: Latent Distillation for Continual Object Detection at the Edge
arxiv-2409-01872.creator: Francesco Pasti, Marina Ceccon, Davide Dalle Pezze, Francesco Paissan, Elisabetta Farella, Gian Antonio Susto, Nicola Bellotto
arxiv-2409-01872.description: Abstract While numerous methods achieving remarkable performance exist in the Object Detection literature, addressing data distribution shifts remains challenging. Continual Learning (CL) offers solutions to this issue, enabling models to adapt to new data while maintaining performance on previous data. This is particularly pertinent for edge devices, common in dynamic environments like automotive and robotics.

arxiv-2409-08466.title: Explaining Datasets in Words: Statistical Models with Natural Language Parameters
arxiv-2409-08466.creator: Ruiqi Zhong, Heng Wang, Dan Klein, Jacob Steinhardt
arxiv-2409-08466.description: Abstract To make sense of massive data, we often first fit simplified models and then interpret the parameters; for example, we cluster the text embeddings and then interpret the mean parameters of each cluster. arxiv-2411-12196.description: Abstract Group polarization is an important research direction in social media content analysis, attracting many researchers to explore this field. pmc-11500520.description: In this study, the complete mitochondrial genome of Triplophysa erythraea was determined for the first time.
